functions.name: fd_first_free
functions.summary: Finds first free descriptor index in fd bitmap starting at low
functions.contract: /*@ requires low >= 0 && size >= 0; ensures low >= size ==> result == low; ensures low < size && result < size ==> NDBIT(result) & ~fdp->fd_map[NDSLOT(result)] != 0 && (\forall int i; low <= i < result ==> NDBIT(i) & fdp->fd_map[NDSLOT(i)] != 0); ensures low < size && result == size ==> (\forall int i; low <= i < size ==> NDBIT(i) & fdp->fd_map[NDSLOT(i)] != 0); */

loops.shape: linear scan of bitmap slots from off to NDSLOTS(size)
loops.invariant: all slots before off are all-ones, and all bits below off*NDENTRIES in [low, off*NDENTRIES) are set

functions.error_convention: returns size (sentinel) when no free bit found
functions.model_hint: bitmask of used fds with first-zero search

functions.prose_contract: Precondition: the descriptor table has at least one slot. Postcondition: returns the index of the highest set bit in the map (the last used fd), or -1 if the map is empty.

loops.shape: reverse scan of bitmap slots from NDSLOT(fd_nfiles-1) down to 0
loops.invariant: all slots above off contain only zero bits

functions.error_convention: returns -1 when no descriptors are in use

functions.name: _pmap_alloc_l3

functions.name: reclaim_pv_chunk_domain

functions.error_convention: returns negative error code propagated from callbacks, 0 on success

functions.prose_contract: Precondition: parent is the root directory at the given level covering [addr, end). functions.ownership: Borrowed pointers; caller owns the page-table tree.
functions.error_convention: returns negative error code from callbacks, 0 on success
functions.model_hint: restricted traversal of a trie visiting only nodes shared across address ranges
